nodes.label: Next.js breaking changes warning
nodes.rationale: Read node_modules/next/dist/docs before coding.

nodes.label: pnpm test && lint && typecheck before PR
nodes.norm_label: pnpm test && lint && typecheck before pr

nodes.label: Branch + PR workflow, never commit to main
nodes.norm_label: branch + pr workflow, never commit to main

nodes.label: Accessibility and inclusion
nodes.rationale: Mobile-first, 44px+ targets, AA contrast, night use.

nodes.label: Evidence on hand / pending prices and photos
nodes.norm_label: evidence on hand / pending prices and photos
nodes.rationale: Do not invent photos or reviews; sample prices must be marked.

nodes.label: Stack Next.js + TypeScript + Tailwind + Vercel
nodes.rationale: Chosen by owner to scale to Mercado Pago, backend and DB without migrating.

nodes.label: WhatsApp order flow
nodes.rationale: Reduces messages per order; zero badly-taken orders; no commissions or accounts.

nodes.label: R8 Numero de comanda B-XXXX
nodes.rationale: Random client-side since no backend yet.

nodes.label: Formato del mensaje
nodes.rationale: Bold WhatsApp markup, no emojis, thousands separator, consistent structure.

nodes.label: R9 Horario
nodes.rationale: Closed state warns but still allows sending; local decides.

nodes.label: R1 Menu in single typed data file
nodes.norm_label: r1 menu in single typed data file

nodes.label: R10 Persistencia local (localStorage)
nodes.rationale: useSyncExternalStore + localStorage avoids dependencies.

nodes.label: Image detection by filename convention
nodes.rationale: Drop files in public/ and they appear without code changes.

nodes.label: SDD flow and spec index
nodes.rationale: No functionality without a spec.

nodes.label: Spec first rule
nodes.rationale: If scope changes update spec before code.

nodes.label: Product principles
nodes.rationale: Order under one minute; WhatsApp message is the product; zero friction; single menu file; ready to grow.

nodes.label: R5 La comanda es el mensaje
nodes.norm_label: r5 la comanda es el mensaje
nodes.rationale: What the customer sees is what the local receives.

nodes.label: Buttons and pill shapes
nodes.rationale: Build resolved actions and chips as pills, reserving 10px for fields; records deviation from direction.

nodes.label: Comanda termica signature component
nodes.rationale: Each ticket line equals the WhatsApp message text; print animation from printer mouth.

nodes.label: Layout: mobile column, desktop two columns
nodes.norm_label: layout: mobile column, desktop two columns

nodes.label: Printer motion grammar and reduced motion
nodes.norm_label: printer motion grammar and reduced motion

nodes.label: Typography: Gloock, Archivo, Martian Mono
nodes.rationale: Mono only on paper; serif only for names at weight 400.

nodes.label: Positioning: counter in the phone
nodes.rationale: Not a generic delivery platform; no commissions, accounts or login.

nodes.label: Signature move: line prints with clip-path
nodes.norm_label: signature move: line prints with clip-path

nodes.label: Do not use drawer cart with red counter badge
nodes.norm_label: do not use drawer cart with red counter badge

nodes.label: Dorado Con Motivo rule
nodes.rationale: Gold only for brand, price, action or selection.

nodes.label: Creative North Star: La comanda termica del mostrador
nodes.norm_label: creative north star: la comanda termica del mostrador
nodes.rationale: Cart as thermal paper ticket that is literally the WhatsApp text; rejects generic delivery drawer cart with red badge.

nodes.label: Un Paso De Luz tonal elevation rule
nodes.norm_label: un paso de luz tonal elevation rule
nodes.rationale: Depth via tonal steps; only shadow is floating paper strip.

nodes.label: Dos Materiales rule (night vs paper)
nodes.rationale: Every surface is night or paper; paper-* tokens only on paper.

nodes.label: Thesis: thermal ticket is the interface
nodes.norm_label: thesis: thermal ticket is the interface
nodes.rationale: Rejects generic delivery cart drawer; ticket is literally the message the local receives.
